caption: An original thumbnail for the LINZ geodetic marks supporting layer in the 2015 New Zealand terrain basemap reconstruction project.

context: This is a genuine original GIS map-layer preview for the geodetic-mark symbol layer in LINZ’s TileMill-based national terrain basemap project. It documents a 2015 GIS publishing workflow. It is not a full map export, a standalone GIS application screenshot, or proof of an earlier launch. Archive-only until a separate, paragraph-level placement review.
